fact: GIMTEL launched interconnection of bank apps and e-wallets under the Central Bank of Mauritania's strategy, and its governor said oversight of payment systems had been activated.

Agence Ecofin reports Mattel Money, the Mattel subsidiary that launched the Mechili payment service on app and USSD on 22 July 2026, is licensed by the Banque Centrale de Mauritanie as an e-money institution; Mechili handles transfers, deposits, withdrawals and bill payments.
Le Quotidien reports that Mattel's new subsidiary Mattel Money, unveiled on 9 November 2026, is licensed as an e-money institution by the Banque Centrale de Mauritanie.
